household_budget.rule: first day after which the household pool (including the next day's income) holds less than that day's consumer spending

liveness.rule: collapsed when a day's served demand < 0.5 x trailing 28-day mean (>= 7 days of history) while customers with the need exist; recovered at >= 0.8 x that mean
